how.title: Medical care first, delivery second
how.text: Nothing that needs a prescription leaves our fridge without a doctor's approval.

step1.title: Choose
step1.text: Pick a drip, a protocol or a product and tell us where you are staying.

step2.title: Health check
step2.text: Answer a short health questionnaire. It takes about two minutes.

step3.title: Doctor review
step3.text: A licensed doctor approves, adjusts or declines, and calls you if anything is unclear.

step4.title: Pay and receive
step4.text: Pay by QRIS, transfer, card or on delivery. A nurse or a chilled courier comes to you.

villa.title: The lounge comes to you
villa.text: A nurse arrives with everything needed, checks your blood pressure and pulse, and stays with you for the whole infusion. All you need is a comfortable chair.

villa.point2: Call-out fee from {fee}, shown before you confirm
villa.point3: Couples and groups welcome: add a drip for each person

item1.title: A doctor decides, not a shopping cart
item1.text: Prescription items are released only after a licensed doctor has reviewed your health questionnaire.

item2.title: Honest about the evidence
item2.text: We tell you what is well studied and what is still experimental. Several peptides are not approved medicines, and we say so.

item3.title: Cold chain from fridge to door
item3.text: Temperature-sensitive products travel chilled in insulated pouches and are handed over in person.

item4.title: Screened before every drip
item4.text: Your nurse checks vital signs and history before starting, and will decline a treatment that is not right for you.

areas.title: Across South Bali and Ubud
areas.text: Product delivery from {delivery}. Free from {free} of products.

final.title: Not sure where to start?
final.text: Tell us how you feel and what you want to achieve. We will suggest a plan and, where needed, arrange a doctor's review.

iv.title: IV drips
iv.intro: Fluids, vitamins and minerals given directly into a vein by a nurse, at our lounge or at your villa. Your nurse checks your vital signs and medical history before starting.
iv.note: Wellness infusions support hydration and comfort. They do not treat or cure disease. If you are seriously unwell, go to a hospital.

shots.title: Quick injections
shots.intro: Ten minutes at the lounge, or added to a villa visit.

peptides.title: Peptides and injectables
peptides.intro: Protocols for recovery, sleep, skin, immunity and metabolic health. Every item on this page needs a doctor's approval before it is supplied.
peptides.notice: Add what interests you and complete the health questionnaire at checkout. A doctor reviews your request and may approve, adjust or decline it. You pay only after approval.
peptides.evidence: Some items here are registered medicines prescribed for their approved use. Others are research peptides: they are not approved medicines, most evidence comes from laboratory and animal studies, and long-term safety in humans is not established. Your doctor will explain what is and is not known before you decide. Many peptides are prohibited in competitive sport.

supplements.title: Supplements
supplements.intro: A deliberately short list. No doctor review needed: order and we deliver across Bali.
supplements.note: Food supplements do not replace a varied diet. Ask your doctor before use if you take medication, are pregnant or breastfeeding.

memberships.title: Memberships
memberships.intro: One monthly price for regular drips, doctor check-ins and member pricing on everything else.
memberships.note: Memberships run for one month from the day of payment and are renewed by hand: we send you a reminder, nothing is charged automatically. Drips included in a plan are subject to the usual nurse screening.

Catalog.sample: Sample menu: names, contents and prices are placeholders.

iv-hydration.name: Island Hydration
iv-hydration.tagline: The reset after heat, travel or a long surf.
iv-hydration.description: A litre of balanced fluids with electrolytes and B vitamins to rehydrate faster than drinking alone. The simplest drip on our menu and a good first infusion.
iv-hydration.contents: Balanced electrolyte solution 1000 ml; B-complex vitamins

iv-bali-belly.name: Bali Belly Relief
iv-bali-belly.tagline: Fluids and comfort when your stomach has had enough.
iv-bali-belly.description: Rehydration for traveller's diarrhoea and vomiting, with electrolytes and B vitamins. Anti-nausea or stomach medication is added only when the nurse and doctor consider it appropriate. High fever, blood in the stool or symptoms lasting more than three days need a hospital, not a drip.
iv-bali-belly.contents: Balanced electrolyte solution 1000 ml; B-complex vitamins; anti-nausea medication if clinically appropriate

iv-morning-after.name: Morning After
iv-morning-after.tagline: For the day after a long night.
iv-morning-after.description: Fluids, electrolytes, B vitamins and vitamin C to ease dehydration and fatigue after alcohol. It will not lower your blood alcohol level and does not make driving safe.
iv-morning-after.contents: Balanced electrolyte solution 1000 ml; B-complex vitamins; vitamin C 1 g

iv-immune.name: Immune Support
iv-immune.tagline: Vitamin C and zinc when everyone around you is sniffling.
iv-immune.description: A vitamin and mineral infusion chosen by travellers at the start of a trip or during a busy season. Evidence that IV vitamins prevent infections in healthy people is limited.
iv-immune.contents: Saline 500 ml; vitamin C 5 g; zinc; B-complex vitamins

iv-myers.name: Myers' Cocktail
iv-myers.tagline: The classic all-round vitamin and mineral drip.
iv-myers.description: The best-known wellness infusion: magnesium, calcium, B vitamins and vitamin C. Many guests choose it for general tiredness and jet lag.
iv-myers.contents: Saline 500 ml; magnesium; calcium; B-complex vitamins; vitamin B12; vitamin C 2 g

iv-athlete.name: Surf & Train Recovery
iv-athlete.tagline: For heavy training weeks and back-to-back sessions.
iv-athlete.description: Fluids with amino acids, magnesium and vitamins, chosen by surfers, CrossFitters and runners after demanding sessions in the heat.
iv-athlete.contents: Balanced electrolyte solution 1000 ml; amino acid blend; magnesium; B-complex vitamins; vitamin C 2 g

iv-glow.name: Glow
iv-glow.tagline: Glutathione and vitamin C for skin that has seen a lot of sun.
iv-glow.description: An antioxidant infusion with glutathione, vitamin C and biotin. Popular before events. Evidence for skin benefits from IV glutathione is limited and effects, where seen, are temporary.
iv-glow.contents: Saline 500 ml; glutathione 1200 mg; vitamin C 2 g; biotin

iv-nad-250.name: NAD+ 250 mg
iv-nad-250.tagline: A slow infusion for energy and focus.
iv-nad-250.description: NAD+ is a coenzyme every cell uses to produce energy. It is infused slowly over two to three hours because a fast drip can cause chest tightness, nausea or cramping. Research in humans is at an early stage. A doctor reviews your request before booking.

shot-b12.name: Vitamin B12 injection
shot-b12.tagline: A quick shot for energy, popular with plant-based eaters.
shot-b12.description: Intramuscular vitamin B12. Most useful if your intake or levels are low; if they are normal, extra B12 has little effect.

shot-vitamin-d.name: Vitamin D3 injection
shot-vitamin-d.tagline: For people who stay out of the midday sun.
shot-vitamin-d.description: A single intramuscular dose of vitamin D3. Best guided by a blood test, so tell the nurse about any recent results and supplements you already take.

shot-glutathione.name: Glutathione push
shot-glutathione.tagline: The antioxidant from our Glow drip, in fifteen minutes.
shot-glutathione.description: A slow intravenous injection of glutathione, without the full infusion. Evidence for skin or detox benefits is limited.

bpc-157.name: BPC-157
bpc-157.description: A synthetic peptide studied mainly in laboratory and animal research on tendon, ligament, muscle and gut tissue. Human clinical data are very limited and it is not an approved medicine. Prohibited in competitive sport. Supplied only after a doctor's review, with written dosing guidance and follow-up.
bpc-157.contents: BPC-157 5 mg (lyophilised vial); bacteriostatic water; syringes and swabs; written instructions

tb-500.name: TB-500
tb-500.tagline: Often paired with BPC-157 in recovery protocols.
tb-500.description: A synthetic fragment of thymosin beta-4, studied in animals for tissue repair and inflammation. There are no completed large human trials and it is not an approved medicine. Prohibited in competitive sport. Doctor review required.
tb-500.contents: TB-500 5 mg (lyophilised vial); bacteriostatic water; syringes and swabs; written instructions

recovery-stack.name: Recovery Stack
recovery-stack.tagline: BPC-157 and TB-500 together, with one set of instructions.
recovery-stack.description: The two recovery peptides most often used together, supplied as a four-week protocol designed by the reviewing doctor around your injury or training load. The same limits apply: experimental, not approved medicines, prohibited in competitive sport.
recovery-stack.contents: BPC-157 5 mg; TB-500 5 mg; bacteriostatic water; syringes and swabs; written protocol

cjc-ipamorelin.name: CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin
cjc-ipamorelin.tagline: A night-time protocol for sleep and recovery.
cjc-ipamorelin.description: Two peptides that stimulate the body's own growth hormone release, used in the evening. Small human studies show a rise in growth hormone; benefits for sleep, body composition or recovery are not proven. Not an approved medicine, prohibited in competitive sport, and not suitable with a history of cancer. Doctor review required.
cjc-ipamorelin.contents: CJC-1295 (no DAC) 5 mg and ipamorelin 5 mg; bacteriostatic water; syringes and swabs; written instructions

ghk-cu.name: GHK-Cu
ghk-cu.tagline: The copper peptide from skincare, as a protocol.
ghk-cu.description: A copper-binding peptide found naturally in the body and widely used in cosmetic creams. Evidence for injected use is limited to small studies. Doctor review required.
ghk-cu.contents: GHK-Cu 50 mg (lyophilised vial); bacteriostatic water; syringes and swabs; written instructions

epitalon.name: Epitalon
epitalon.tagline: A short course popular in longevity circles.
epitalon.description: A four-amino-acid peptide studied mostly in Russia for sleep rhythm and ageing. Independent, modern clinical trials are lacking and it is not an approved medicine. Doctor review required.
epitalon.contents: Epitalon 10 mg (lyophilised vial); bacteriostatic water; syringes and swabs; written instructions

thymosin-alpha-1.name: Thymosin Alpha-1
thymosin-alpha-1.tagline: An immune-modulating peptide with clinical history.
thymosin-alpha-1.description: A peptide registered as a medicine in a number of countries for specific conditions. Its use for general immune support in healthy people is not established. Not suitable for transplant recipients or people on immunosuppressants. Doctor review required.
thymosin-alpha-1.contents: Thymosin alpha-1 5 mg (lyophilised vial); bacteriostatic water; syringes and swabs; written instructions

nad-injection.name: NAD+ injections
nad-injection.tagline: NAD+ in small doses at home, without the long drip.
nad-injection.description: Subcutaneous NAD+ in small, frequent doses as an alternative to an infusion. Injections can sting and cause brief flushing or nausea. Research in humans is at an early stage. Doctor review required.
nad-injection.contents: NAD+ 500 mg (vial); syringes and swabs; written instructions

glp1-programme.name: Metabolic programme (GLP-1)
glp1-programme.tagline: Doctor-led weight management with registered medication.
glp1-programme.description: A monthly programme for adults with a medical indication for weight management: doctor consultation, a registered GLP-1 medicine prescribed at the dose that suits you, and check-ins on side effects, nutrition and muscle. Not suitable in pregnancy, with a history of pancreatitis or certain thyroid cancers. Eligibility is decided by the doctor.
glp1-programme.contents: Doctor consultation; one month of prescribed GLP-1 medication; nurse onboarding; fortnightly check-ins

electrolytes.name: Daily Electrolytes
electrolytes.tagline: Sodium, potassium and magnesium for hot days.
electrolytes.description: Sugar-free electrolyte sachets for the climate, the surf and the gym. One sachet in 500 ml of water.
electrolytes.contents: Sodium; potassium; magnesium; natural citrus flavour

magnesium-glycinate.name: Magnesium Glycinate
magnesium-glycinate.tagline: A gentle form of magnesium, taken in the evening.
magnesium-glycinate.description: Magnesium bound to glycine, chosen for being easy on the stomach. Magnesium contributes to normal muscle function and to the reduction of tiredness.
magnesium-glycinate.contents: Magnesium bisglycinate, 200 mg elemental magnesium per two capsules

collagen-peptides.name: Marine Collagen Peptides
collagen-peptides.tagline: The only peptide on our list you stir into coffee.
collagen-peptides.description: Hydrolysed marine collagen, unflavoured, dissolves in hot or cold drinks. Ten grams a day.
collagen-peptides.contents: Hydrolysed fish collagen (types I and III)

creatine.name: Creatine Monohydrate
creatine.tagline: The most studied supplement in sport.
creatine.description: Micronised creatine monohydrate. Three to five grams a day increases physical performance in short, high-intensity efforts.

omega-3.name: Omega-3
omega-3.tagline: EPA and DHA from fish oil.
omega-3.description: Concentrated fish oil softgels. EPA and DHA contribute to the normal function of the heart.
omega-3.contents: Fish oil concentrate, 1000 mg EPA and DHA per two softgels

member-essentials.name: Essentials
member-essentials.tagline: Stay topped up through your stay.
member-essentials.description: Two classic drips a month and member pricing on everything else.
member-essentials.contents: 2 classic IV drips a month (up to Myers' Cocktail); 10% off products and extra drips; priority booking

member-performance.name: Performance
member-performance.tagline: For people who train hard and want a doctor in their corner.
member-performance.description: A weekly drip, a monthly doctor check-in and free delivery.
member-performance.contents: 4 IV drips a month (any except NAD+); 1 doctor check-in a month; 15% off products and extra drips; free product delivery; priority booking

member-longevity.name: Longevity
member-longevity.tagline: Our complete plan, built around NAD+ and regular review.
member-longevity.description: Weekly drips, a monthly NAD+ infusion and a doctor who follows your protocol.
member-longevity.contents: 4 IV drips a month; 1 NAD+ 250 mg infusion a month; doctor review every month; 20% off products; free villa call-out and delivery

HowItWorks.title: How it works
HowItWorks.intro: Ordering from us takes a few minutes. The medical part happens in the background, and it is the reason we exist.

step1.title: Choose what you need
step1.text: Browse drips, peptides, supplements and memberships. Add them to your basket and tell us whether you are coming to the lounge or want us to come to you.

step2.title: Answer the health questionnaire
step2.text: For drips, injections and prescription items we ask about your age, medical conditions, allergies and medication. Your answers are seen only by the medical team.

step3.title: A doctor reviews prescription items
step3.text: A licensed doctor reads your questionnaire and approves, adjusts or declines the request. If something needs discussing, the doctor contacts you on WhatsApp. Supplements and classic drips skip this step.

step4.title: Pay the way you prefer
step4.text: QRIS, virtual-account transfer, e-wallet, international card, manual bank transfer, or cash and QRIS on delivery. Prescription items are payable only after approval.

step5.title: Receive
step5.text: We confirm your two-hour window on WhatsApp. A nurse arrives for sessions; products come by chilled courier or with the nurse.

team.title: Who looks after you
team.text: We work with independent, licensed Indonesian doctors and registered nurses. The doctor is responsible for every prescribing decision; the nurse for the safe administration of your treatment.

doctor.title: Doctors
doctor.text: Review questionnaires, prescribe, write your protocol and are reachable for follow-up questions.

nurse.title: Nurses
nurse.text: Check your vital signs, place the IV, stay with you throughout and know when to stop.

care.title: Care team
care.text: Schedule visits, keep the cold chain and answer WhatsApp every day from {opens} to {closes}.

safety.title: When we say no
safety.text: We do not treat under-18s, and we will not supply a product the doctor considers unsafe for you, including during pregnancy and breastfeeding for most items. If the doctor declines, you are not charged.
safety.emergency: We are not an emergency service. For chest pain, difficulty breathing, severe dehydration or any emergency, call 112 or go to the nearest hospital.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.intro: Short, straight answers. If yours is missing, ask us on WhatsApp.

q1.q: Do I need a doctor to order peptides?
q1.a: Yes. Peptides and other prescription items are supplied only after a licensed doctor has reviewed your health questionnaire. The doctor may approve, adjust or decline the request, and may contact you first. You pay only after approval.

q2.q: How long does the doctor's review take?
q2.a: We aim to answer the same day for requests received during opening hours. You get a message with a link to your order as soon as there is a decision.

q3.a: Some products we supply are registered medicines prescribed for their approved use. Several others, including BPC-157, TB-500 and Epitalon, are research peptides: they are not approved medicines, most of the evidence comes from laboratory and animal studies, and long-term safety in humans is not established. Your doctor explains this before you decide.

q4.q: I compete in a tested sport. Can I use peptides?
q4.a: Probably not. BPC-157, TB-500, CJC-1295, ipamorelin and several others are prohibited at all times under the World Anti-Doping Code. Check with your federation before ordering, and tell the doctor that you are tested.

q5.a: A registered nurse. Before starting, the nurse checks your blood pressure, pulse and medical history, and can adjust or decline the treatment. The nurse stays with you until the drip is finished.

q6.q: Can you come to my villa or hotel?
q6.a: Yes, in the areas listed on the delivery page. You choose a two-hour arrival window, and the call-out fee for your area is shown before you confirm.

q7.q: How are peptides delivered and stored?
q7.a: Chilled, in an insulated pouch, handed to you in person. Keep them in the fridge at 2 to 8 °C. Each order includes an injection kit and the doctor's written instructions.

q8.a: QRIS, virtual-account bank transfer, e-wallets, Indonesian and international cards, manual bank transfer, or cash and QRIS when the nurse or courier arrives. Prices are in Indonesian rupiah.

q9.q: Who should not have a drip or a peptide protocol?
q9.a: We do not treat under-18s. Most products are unsuitable during pregnancy and breastfeeding, and some are unsuitable with heart, kidney or liver disease, a history of cancer or G6PD deficiency. That is what the questionnaire and the doctor's review are for.

q10.a: You can reschedule or cancel a visit free of charge up to three hours before your window. If the doctor declines your request you are not charged. Unopened supplements can be returned within seven days. Prescription and chilled items cannot be returned once delivered.

q11.a: No. We deliver in Bali only.

q12.a: No. For chest pain, difficulty breathing, fainting, severe dehydration or any emergency, call 112 or go to the nearest hospital.

approved.text: Good news: the doctor has approved your request. Use the link below to choose how you would like to pay. We prepare your order as soon as payment is confirmed.
approved.partly: The doctor has approved part of your request. The link below shows what was approved and lets you choose how to pay.

declined.subject: {brand}: about your order {id}
declined.text: After reviewing your health questionnaire, the doctor could not approve this request. Nothing has been charged. Reply to this message or write to us on WhatsApp if you would like to talk it through.

confirmed.subject: {brand}: order {id} confirmed
confirmed.text: We have received your payment and your order is confirmed. We will message you on WhatsApp to confirm the time.

onTheWay.subject: {brand}: order {id} is on the way
onTheWay.text: Your nurse or courier is on the way.
